Question: Assalmvaleku.. Mufti saheb I want to know Names meaning.... 1) Mohammed Muvaz 2) Mohammed Hasib M. Answer ID: 12691 Posted on: Aug 29, 2020 Bismillah hir-Rahman nir-Rahim ! (Fatwa: 752/723=B/1430) Mu?aaz means: One who is given refuge or protection, while Hasib means: sufficient or one who reckons. Allah (Subhana Wa Ta'ala) knows Best Darul Ifta, Darul Uloom Deoband, India
